Internal calculation: stepped wedge power (Hussey & Hughes 2007 Eq 8)

Source: R/calc-complex.R
calculate_stepped_wedge.Rd

WLS-based Wald power for the treatment effect in a full CS stepped wedge design. Requires (I, T, cluster_size m, tau2, sigma2_ind) — the variance of the treatment effect estimate is computed from the design matrix quadratic forms U/W/V, then power = Phi(|theta|/se - z_(1-a/2)).

Usage

calculate_stepped_wedge(
  theta,
  tau2,
  sigma2_ind,
  m,
  n_clusters,
  clusters_per_step,
  alpha,
  outcome = "mean"
)

Details

Anchor: H&H EPT example — I=24 counties, T=5 (baseline + 4 steps of 6), m=100, binary outcome p=0.05 (sigma2_ind = p(1-p) = 0.0475), CV=0.3 -> tau2 = (0.3*0.05)^2 = 2.25e-4. This implementation returns power = 0.959 at RR=0.64 and 0.870 at RR=0.70 (transparent Eq-8 computation; the paper's Fig 2 "about 80% at RR~0.64" is a figure reading and corresponds to RR ~ 0.73 under Eq 8 at 80% — discrepancy documented in NUMERIC_ANCHORS.md).
